answer: Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the wander audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 148 to 320 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the beacon identity is graded at all. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, as the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the mirror band is published for each class. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
